annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses preserve the same decision-relevant evidence: they each propose investigating logs/traces to understand the retry/duplicate-upload mechanism, and they each recommend an upload-flow correction based on idempotency or deduplication to prevent multiple stored attachments. Each also justifies the correction by tying it to reducing duplicates caused by repeated attempts. B includes a bit more specificity about comparing client/server request IDs and explicitly notes confirming the retry source, but this does not materially change the identified cause, correction, or justification.
